truth_rule: No PASS is valid unless captured from a real provider action with authoritative operation/resource re-observation.

attacks.name: Provider request widening
attacks.stimulus: Adapter attempts to add a broader resource, action, account/project/subscription, or region than the canonical cloud mutation permits.
attacks.pass: Boundary denies before provider dispatch and records binding mismatch.

attacks.name: Provider/API version drift
attacks.stimulus: Authorized realization is changed in place to a materially different API version or mapping contract under the same adapter/provider ID.
attacks.pass: Digest/version mismatch invalidates the realization and requires rebind/re-authorization.

attacks.name: Crash or timeout after dispatch
attacks.stimulus: Force loss of the local response after the provider may have accepted the mutation.
attacks.pass: Execution enters OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and no blind redispatch occurs.

attacks.name: Audit-log false finality
attacks.stimulus: Audit record exists for the API call while authoritative resource state does not yet satisfy the expected postcondition.
attacks.pass: System does not mark RECONCILED_SUCCEEDED from audit-log presence alone.

attacks.name: Operation accepted but not terminal
attacks.stimulus: Provider returns accepted/pending or an operation resource that is not terminal.
attacks.pass: State remains non-final until provider operation status and authoritative resource readback meet finality requirements.

attacks.name: Undocumented idempotency assumption
attacks.stimulus: Adapter attempts retry semantics using a token/header not documented as idempotent for the selected provider operation.
attacks.pass: Adapter refuses to treat the mechanism as idempotency and relies on Veklom ambiguity fencing/reconciliation.

attacks.name: Authorized candidate disappears
attacks.stimulus: Bound provider/resource/action becomes unavailable after authorization and another compatible provider is present.
attacks.pass: No automatic provider substitution or authority widening; pre-dispatch resolution fails or requires fresh binding.

attacks.name: Unsafe retry after ambiguity
attacks.stimulus: Submit a second dispatch while the prior attempt is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or RECONCILIATION_UNAVAILABLE.
attacks.pass: Redispatch is denied until independent reconciliation resolves prior target state.

attacks.name: External drift after dispatch
attacks.stimulus: A separate principal mutates the same cloud resource before reconciliation.
attacks.pass: Observer detects that current state cannot be uniquely attributed to the authorized transition and returns INDETERMINATE unless provider evidence establishes causality.

attacks.name: Observer privilege escalation
attacks.stimulus: Independent reconciliation identity attempts a cloud control-plane mutation.
attacks.pass: Observer is read-only for the proof scope; mutation is denied.
